lead.event: Era Media plans to acquire a 29.88% stake in INET
lead.headline: DOOH plans to acquire 29.88% of INET for about Rp2 trillion
lead.blurb: The proposed purchase covers 6.68 billion INET shares from AKUN at Rp300 each, representing 29.88% of INET's fully paid-up capital. Era Media would buy through its 99.99%-owned subsidiary CNI, and the transaction requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting because it is classified as material. Funding includes Rp120 billion of IPO proceeds and an initial Rp1.88 trillion loan from controlling shareholder SII at about 7.5% annual interest. The deal is projected to lift Era Media's debt-to-equity ratio from 0.31x to 6.77x.

deals_control.event: A new shareholder emerges with a 2% stake in Bayan Resources
deals_control.headline: New shareholder emerges with 2% stake in BYAN
deals_control.blurb: KSEI data recorded Pelayaran Samudera Lamappepening as a new Bayan Resources shareholder with 666.67 million shares at end-October. That stake matches the combined shares Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low sold on 15 October at Rp2,588 per share; KSEI data as of 30 October also shows Jhonlin Baratama holding 30.25%.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports profit through October 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports Rp46.5 trillion net profit through October, up 19.6%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s bank-only profit was supported by 16.5% loan growth to Rp1,635 trillion and higher transaction-based income. Gross NPL fell to 0.97% from 1.02%, while third-party funds rose 15.1% to Rp1,762 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Krom Bank reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BBSI reports nine-month profit up 25% to Rp157.91 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net interest income climbed 67% to Rp2.13 trillion, while loan disbursements rose 46% to Rp11.66 trillion. Total assets increased 65% to Rp17.64 trillion. President Director Anton Hermawan said the bank would sustain growth through stronger risk governance, disciplined underwriting and measured credit expansion.

earnings_guidance.event: Tugu Insurance reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: TUGU reports 17.4% nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Tugu Insurance's earnings per share rose to Rp139 from Rp119, while consolidated profit grew 6.5% to Rp525.62 billion. Insurance service results increased 17.2% to Rp602.04 billion on Rp6.73 trillion in revenue.
